paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Vayera 23; there, at Toledot 19, he speaks in R' Berekhyah’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied title is abbreviated ר׳. The Buber Tanchuma digital text, Toldot 19, fully writes Rav Aristi (רב אריסטי) reporting Rabbi Berekhyah; Vayera 23 has ר׳ אריסטי חברינו. These matching passages also identify the Tanchuma edition used for the comparison.

The actual Buber Tanchuma passages have R' Aristi in Vayera 23 and full Rav Aristi in Toldot 19. The latter has בשם ר' ברכיה, so the body retains R' Berekhyah rather than expanding that abbreviated title. The earlier mixed note is kept verbatim; its Rabbi rendering does not substitute for occurrence-specific full-title evidence. No identity or reported teaching is added.
